title: Pair With Target Sum
description:
You are given a list of integers and a target value. Exactly one pair of different positions i < j has a[i] + a[j] equal to the target. Print that pair of positions (0-based).

Input format
Line 1: n, the number of integers.
Line 2: n space-separated integers.
Line 3: the target value.

Output format
Two integers i and j (i < j) separated by a space.
constraints: 2 <= n <= 100000. Values fit in a 32-bit signed integer. Exactly one valid pair exists.
hints: Checking every pair works but is slow for large n. What could you remember about numbers you have already passed?
For each number x, the partner you need is target - x. A hash map from value to position lets you look the partner up in constant time.
Scan left to right. Before storing x, check whether target - x is already in the map; if it is, you have the answer. Store x only afterwards, so a number never pairs with itself.
